spec: Pre-baked vehicle designs and the mods they take (sim/works/vehicles). parts: what the assembly yard puts together. cap: goods a convoy trip carries. speed: road days are divided by it. armor: cuts raid odds and battle losses. fire: weight in a battle. fuel: spent from the depot each trip or march. slots: mods it takes. flies: ignores broken roads and raiders. The Wright's catalogue sells any part (and whole vehicles) at catalogueMul times the parts' price.

designs.name: Handcart
designs.blurb: Two wheels and a stubborn back. Carries a little, fast.

designs.name: Ox wagon
designs.blurb: The workhorse of the roads. Eats grain each trip.

designs.name: War cart
designs.blurb: A shielded wagon bristling with spears. The first war machine.

designs.name: Steam wagon
designs.blurb: Iron and steam. Twice the pace, twice the load, burns charcoal.

designs.name: Landship
designs.blurb: A walled town on wheels. Gates do not hold against it.

designs.name: Airship
designs.blurb: Lifted by a kindled spark. The only way past the edge of the map.

mods.name: Spare wheel
mods.blurb: Half the wear on every trip.

mods.name: Field stove
mods.blurb: Cooks on the march: a band eats a quarter less.
